reuse.why: Hooks the new check into assertBankAccountNotLinked, the precheck every provider link function already calls before touching the bank or accounts.

duplication.why: One added check in one place; no provider function is edited.

placement.why: The link-precondition helper is the right spot, though its name (assertBankAccountNotLinked) no longer describes the closed-account rule it now also enforces.

scope.why: A single focused addition to the shared precheck.

maintainability.why: Simple and covers all six link paths; a rename or a separate assertLinkTargetOpen helper would make the precondition clearer to future readers.

one_place.where: server/accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, called first by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount, linkFintegraAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
